passenger_response.subject: Your disruption and downgrade claim – AER-3B7Y5K
passenger_response.body:
Dear Tomas Ferreira,

Our record shows that flight AK640 on 2026-08-01 was cancelled because of a cabin pressurisation fault. You were re-accommodated on AK644. The arrival delay at your final destination was 220 minutes.

The record therefore supports compensation of GBP 175.00. The distance was 1585 km, which places the journey in Band B. The technical cause was within Aerlink’s control. The standard Band B amount is GBP 350.00, reduced by 50% because you were re-routed and the arrival delay was below 300 minutes.

Our record also shows that you were carried in ECONOMY after booking BUSINESS. The downgrade reimbursement is GBP 240.00. This is 50% of the affected segment S2 fare of GBP 480.00. It is not based on the booking total of GBP 1240.00, and it does not include taxes, charges or ancillaries. This reimbursement is additional to the compensation, not a replacement for it.

The recorded total payable is GBP 415.00. This covers GBP 175.00 compensation and GBP 240.00 for the downgrade. Your calculation differs because it uses the booking total rather than the affected segment fare, and because the compensation is based on the 220-minute arrival delay and the applicable reduction after re-routing.

A payment of GBP 415.00 has not been made. This needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Yours sincerely,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
